data.long_meaning: The meaning of Nicholas is recorded in name-lists as “Victory of the people”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nicholas expresses “Victory of the people”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nicholas total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Greek nikē, 'victory', + laos, 'people' — 'victory of the people'. Its root is Greek nikē + laos. Saint Nicholas, bishop of Myra. Nicholas is a Greek name meaning “Victory of the people”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
